paper_title: A Sound and Complete Substitution Algorithm for Multimode Type Theory
classifications: Theory of computation → Modal and temporal logics
statement: When translating an (explicitly) substituted WSMTT expression t [ σ ]ws , we translate both the expression t and the substitution σ and then apply Theorem 9 (i.e. the algorithm from the previous section). Translation of a composite substitution involves the concatenation of the two translated substitutions, which are regular SFMTT substitutions so sequences of atomic SFMTT substitutions. Recall that the operations _ . µµ and + for regular SFMTT substitutions are defined at the end of Section 3.1.
